known_calibration_role: Repeatedly inspected descriptive development only; never independent validation
selection_rule: Maximize train out-of-fold balanced accuracy, then minimum class recall, then prefer zero-shot mean, linear mean, other zero-shot pooling, concatenated linear features. No calibration or contamination outcome used.

mil.reason: Only 72 BC / 48 grade training slides, 512-dimensional input, unknown patient IDs; an attention model adds learned tile-weight parameters without sufficient independent groups for credible complexity selection.

preprocessing: StandardScaler fit separately on training portion of every inner/outer fold; no scaling before splitting. Mean/max/top-K are deterministic within-slide transforms. Native annotation, size, coordinates, identities and coverage are never model features.
probabilities: Balanced logistic outputs are not calibrated probabilities; report descriptive Brier and five fixed bins without fitting a calibration map.
